title: Sentinel-2 Mean NDVI — Assam Revenue Circles (Monthly)
description: Mean Normalised Difference Vegetation Index per Revenue Circle in Assam, derived from Sentinel-2 imagery, used as a natural-environment exposure covariate in the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Vegetation-cover exposure covariate for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model.
details: RDLS's metric_dimension codelist (structure/content/product/disruption/population) has no clean fit for a vegetation index; 'content' is used here as the least-inaccurate available option. License confirmed as 'Creative Commons CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO' per the risk model's data dictionary; recorded here as 'CC-BY-SA-3.0-IGO' (open codelist, custom value) to match RDLS's dash-separated convention.

gazetteer_entries.description: Assam Revenue Circles administrative boundaries (the object_id used across IDS-DRR variables) — a custom scheme, not yet a registered RDLS gazetteer.

resources.title: Harmonized mean NDVI variable (master)
resources.description: Harmonized monthly mean_ndvi per Revenue Circle (object_id), used directly as an IDS-DRR model input.
